# tails

> Fast, batched extreme-value analysis in Python (GEV, GPD, POT, IDF curves).
> Import: `import tails`. PyPI name: `rare-tails`.

The library fits extreme-value models to one series or to thousands in a
single call, with profile-likelihood and bootstrap return-level intervals,
non-stationary linear predictors, and a duration-dependent IDF module.
Bundled data: Environment and Climate Change Canada IDF v3.40, all 151
Québec stations.

## Install

pip install rare-tails

## One-liner

import tails
from tails.datasets import load_eccc_quebec
y = load_eccc_quebec(); y = y.loc[y.station_id == "701S001", "24h"].to_numpy()
fit = tails.fit_gev(y)
fit.return_level([20, 100], ci="profile")
# 20-year 24-h level 84.9 mm; 100-year 102.1 mm (95% profile CI 90.5–131.1)
